description:
The shared jmap-types::ChangesResponse omits the optional 'updatedProperties' field that several /changes methods are spec'd to return:

- RFC 8621 Email/changes, Mailbox/changes, Thread/changes
- RFC 9425 Quota/changes

Typed clients silently drop this field on deserialize (serde permissive default), so the protocol works but the client cannot use it for the documented optimisation (re-fetching only specific properties via back-reference).

Options for fixing this without breaking the cookie-cutter foundation:
1. Add an optional 'updated_properties: Option<Vec<String>>' field to the base ChangesResponse in jmap-types with #[serde(default)] so it round-trips cleanly. Backward-compatible additive change, but propagates across every /changes call site.
2. Define per-extension ChangesResponse newtypes (e.g. EmailChangesResponse, QuotaChangesResponse) that flatten ChangesResponse and add the field. Avoids touching the canonical type but creates N+1 nearly-identical structs.

Discovered while implementing JMAP-g7wu.2.3 (Quota/changes in jmap-chat-client). Filed as P4 because the missing field is an optimisation hint, not required for correctness.
title: Surface updatedProperties on /changes responses (RFC 8621 §2.4, §4.5, §5.5; RFC 9425 §4.3)
